title: feat(app-shell,plugin-list,plugin-grid,i18n): the Display menu's Open records section writes the reader's drawer | split preference; the name cell's ↗ opens the record as the full page
body:
Fixes #26681

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

Part of the record-page-v2 epic #26676 (child 4 of 4). Implements the maintainer's ruling 1 of 2026-10-27, quoted on the card: 「……split / popover 变成用户个人偏好……」 — the side-by-side pane is each reader's own choice, not metadata.

## What changes

- **Display menu, 「打开记录」 section** (`ViewSettingsPopover`, after Layout, before Group). For a row that resolves to `drawer`: two segments 抽屉 | 分屏 writing the reader's preference (per browser, across objects, `os:record-open-mode`), and the note 「个人偏好，不进对象声明；两种都能展开为整页」. For an object or view that resolves to `page`: the read-only line 「此对象声明为整页打开」, no segments. For `new_window` / `none`: no section (see Acceptance notes). A host that passes no `recordOpen` (every host but the console) draws no section.
- **The preference is live** (`app-shell/src/utils/recordOpenPreference.ts`): the write side `writeRecordOpenPreference` (its storage type is `Storage` narrowed to `setItem`; no storage or a refused write throws nothing and the choice still holds on the page) and `useRecordOpenPreference`, a `useSyncExternalStore` pair that hears this page's writes and another tab's `storage` event. `ObjectView` replaces its read-once `useState(readRecordOpenPreference)` with it, so choosing 分屏 makes the next row click open the split face with no reload or remount.
- **The name cell's ↗** (`app-shell/src/views/objectViewOpenAsPage.tsx`): beside the row's record link, hover-revealed by opacity (the `RowActionMenu` class set, so it keeps its Tab stop; a coarse pointer always shows it), `aria-label` and `title` 「整页打开」 (`console.objectView.openAsPage`). It is a real anchor at the host's `recordHref`; a plain click goes through the host's `openRecord` — the record route with the list as origin, the same destination as the drawer's own expand — and stops before the row's click, so neither the drawer nor the pane opens and the preference is untouched. Drawn only for a drawer-mode row: a `page` row already opens the page, and `none` opens nothing.
- **Grid host channel `recordLinkAdornment`** (`ObjectGrid` → `LinkCell`, relayed by `ListView`): a host node after the record link, never inside it, beside the first column the view links (`link: true`), else beside the auto-linked primary field. Absent, the link cell is byte-identical to before (the `ObjectGrid.linkCellAnchor` markup pin stays green).
- **i18n**: five `list.*` keys and `console.objectView.openAsPage` in all ten packs, plus the `ListView` defaults-map rows the `defaults-maps-mirror-en-pack` test holds to the en pack.

No metadata is added and `navigation` reading is unchanged; `packages/spec/**` is not touched, nor any file of #26679 (`navigation-overlay.tsx`, `objectViewRecordNavigation.ts`, `RelatedRecordActionsBridge.tsx`, `RecordDetailView.tsx`).

## Route taken against the dispatch's mechanism hypotheses

- **The props do not travel through plugin-view's `PluginObjectView`.** `ObjectView`'s `renderListView` callback (`objectViewListRenderer.tsx`) renders `ListView` itself, so `recordOpen` goes ObjectView → `renderListView` → `ListView` → `ViewSettingsPopover`, one hop shorter; `PluginObjectView` is unchanged. Both new props are React host props (function values / host state), never node keys: nothing enters `GRID_QUERY_INPUTS` or the SDUI manifest.
- **The ↗ first went through the grid's existing `rowAdornment` channel and was moved off it.** Measured on HotCRM contacts: `rowAdornment` sits beside the row's TITLE (the declared name field's column when shown, else the first shown column), and contact's `nameField: 'full_name'` is not a column, so the arrow landed in the avatar column, away from 「名」 where the row opens. Hence the new `recordLinkAdornment` channel at the link cell (screenshot below).

## Screenshots (HotCRM `1f3f8880` on a fresh DB, console served from this branch's `ui/` src)

Evidence lives on a never-merged branch, commit `964025cf3f3f7a2ecfd4a743d250699f2ec552ec`.

![leads Display menu](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/blob/964025cf3f3f7a2ecfd4a743d250699f2ec552ec/evidence/issue-26681-2026-10-28/lead-display.png?raw=true)

Opportunities (declares `drawer`) — the two segments and the note:

![opportunities Display menu](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/blob/964025cf3f3f7a2ecfd4a743d250699f2ec552ec/evidence/issue-26681-2026-10-28/opportunity-display.png?raw=true)

Contacts, first row hovered — the ↗ beside 「John」, the record link:

![contacts row hover](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/blob/964025cf3f3f7a2ecfd4a743d250699f2ec552ec/evidence/issue-26681-2026-10-28/contact-row-hover.png?raw=true)

## Tests

Measured on head `3d7fb4c462` (branch tip after merging `origin/main`), from `ui/`:

- `pnpm exec vitest run --maxWorkers=3 packages/app-shell/ packages/plugin-grid/ packages/plugin-list/ packages/i18n/` — `Test Files 2307 passed | 1 skipped (2308)`, `Tests 21776 passed | 22 skipped (21798)`, exit 0.
- New suites: `plugin-list/src/__tests__/ViewSettingsPopover.recordOpen-26681.test.tsx` (drawer segments and note, Split writes `split`, the pressed segment writes nothing, `page` read-only line, no section for `new_window` / `none` / no prop, zh pack); `plugin-grid/src/__tests__/ObjectGrid.recordLinkAdornment-26681.test.tsx` (node beside the authored link as the anchor's sibling, one per row, none on the auto-linked first column, absent prop leaves no wrapper, click never reaches the row); `app-shell/src/views/ObjectView.recordOpenDisplay-26681.test.tsx` (choosing 分屏 keeps `split` and the next row click draws the split face; no choice opens the drawer; a `page` view shows the read-only line and no ↗; the ↗ is an anchor at the record route beside the link, and a click lands on the record route with no drawer and no preference written); `app-shell/src/utils/recordOpenPreference.test.ts` gains the write side.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/i18n --filter @object-ui/plugin-grid --filter @object-ui/plugin-list --filter @object-ui/app-shell run type-check` (after building the three libraries' `dist`) — exit 0, each `type-check` script echoed.
- Reverse verification of the cross-package type (`ListViewProps['recordOpen']`, read by app-shell from plugin-list's rebuilt `.d.ts`), via `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` with a trap restore, committed state first: replacing `resolvedMode: navOverlay.mode` with `resolvedMode: 'split' as const` turns app-shell's `tsc --noEmit` red — `TS2322: Type '"split"' is not assignable to type '"none" | "drawer" | "page" | "new_window"'`, exit 2; restored, blob back to `43072da53b2a`, `git diff HEAD` empty. A first attempt that added an extra key instead stayed green (exit 0): a contextually typed arrow's return gets no excess-property check, so that leg proved nothing and was replaced, not counted.

## Acceptance notes

- `new_window` / `none` draw no Open records section: the preference changes nothing there and the ruling gives those declarations no line of their own. A reader of such an object sees no setting rather than a control that does nothing.
- The section is drawn in the Display popover only; the wide toolbar (`compactToolbar: false`) has no twin. No host that passes `recordOpen` draws the wide form — the console never relays a view's `compactToolbar` to `ListView` — so the popover's "change one, change both" note now names this exception.
- The ↗'s zh tooltip 「整页打开」 follows the dispatch's ruling text; the drawer's own expand control reads `console.objectView.expandToPage` 「以完整页面打开」 for the same English sentence. Two zh spellings of one action on one page — noted, not changed here (the drawer's controls belong to #26679).
- The ↗ is drawn for the grid only (`recordLinkAdornment` reaches `ObjectGrid`); kanban, gallery and the other visualizations open records from cards with no name cell.
